meta.title: API reference
meta.description: Vink's REST API: authenticate with an API Key, list Forms and their Fields, and handle errors. Generated from the OpenAPI 3.1 document.

header.title: The Vink API
header.subtitle: Let your own program or automation platform talk to Vink. Everything on this page comes from the same OpenAPI document the API serves.

overview.title: Overview
overview.base: Every endpoint lives under one base URL. The version is in the path: /v1.
overview.json: Requests and answers are JSON, and every key is snake_case, the same as in the webhook Payload. Ids are strings.
overview.versioning: Within /v1 we only add: new endpoints, new optional parameters and new keys in answers. Ignore keys you don't know. Anything that would break your code gets a new version.
overview.openapi: Download the <link>OpenAPI 3.1 document</link> to generate a client or import it into a tool.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.keys: Send an API Key with every request. An Admin makes one under Organisation settings → API Keys in the app, gives it a name and sees it once. A key belongs to one Organisation and only reaches that Organisation's data.
auth.secret: Treat a key like a password: keep it on your server, never in a browser or app. A missing, unknown or revoked key gets 401. Revoking one key leaves your other keys working.

errors.title: Errors
errors.intro: A failed request gets a 4xx or 5xx status and the same JSON body. Branch on code; message is for people and may change.
